{{Quote|We are advancing in this movement. You have done well, and it has been rewarded. Glory in the honor, Seelah&mdash;it is the greatest that can befall such as us.|Seelah's father, after her appointment to caring for Ludo Kressh's feet|<ref name="Paragon" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''father''' of [[Seelah Korsin]], a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. As a descendant of the original [[Tapani refugee]]s that had crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhelg/Legends|Rhelg]], he and his people excelled at science. This man, along with his entire family, was in the service of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ludo Kressh]] in the years leading up to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. At some point prior to [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Seelah&mdash;who was tasked with the care of Ludo Kressh's feet&mdash;failed to stop an infection on one of Kressh's ankles stemming from a wound that he had received during a battle. As punishment, Kressh executed the whole family, barring Seelah, starting with this man.<ref name="Paragon" />
